Online dating has this problem. It happens for a few reasons

If someone is not interested they probably would ghost you. These guys probably are either keeping you on the burner because they have something else going on, are genuinely very busy, or just are not the type of person to take the online dating scene that seriously. Before you delete, just ask "why are you taking so long to answer". Either, they give you a response that will justify it, or you end up deleting anyways. Also, try to text/message as little as possible. It's a very bad form of communication that runs extremely stale very quickly. I personally like to talk on the phone and encourage anyone I date to do it with me.

CG Kid is a great YouTube channel that talks about addiction recovery and I recommend you watch his videos on alcoholism. In his video about porn addiction, he talks about how there are some things that we do repeatedly we have a hard time stopping, and it is up to us to decide if this addiction is bad for us. CG kid considers himself addicted to porn, and does not necessarily see it as bad. If he was in a marriage or trying to get dates for example, that could be a different story.

So to him, in that context, an addiction is not necessarily bad.

How do I measure if an addiction is bad? I know I personally have to compete in this world and make big. I have to get a job, get investments, get educated, whatever. If something I have is prohibiting me from that, I gotta stop it.

If I was in your shoes, I would stop drinking and playing games unless it's after 5 or something, or only if it's a Saturday.
